title: EMTEK SELECT Entry Handlesets
summary: EMTEK SELECT Entry Handlesets. Designed to Be Personalized
body_markdown:
### Designed to Be Personalized


New[EMTEK SELECT Entry Handlesets](https://www.emtek.com/select-entry-sets/) give homeowners hundreds of unique combinations of elegant finishes, eye-catching textures, and profiles to choose from.


Every handleset is solid brass and assembled to order, with mix-and-match components that make the front entry entirely their own, and designed to coordinate with the full EMTEK SELECT lineup.


Tubular and Mortise options are available in multiple finishes.
